name: Ultegra eleven-speed rim-brake Dual Control lever pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average: complete left/right ST-R8000-L and ST-R8000-R mechanical 2×11-speed rim-brake Dual Control lever pair. The Japanese 2020 Bike Gear catalogue explicitly labels 438 g as a pair weight. Cables are listed as package contents, but their inclusion in the reference weight is not stated.
